summary: Frontend-only validation completed for newly added Writing and Patent pages against references, links, navigation behavior, responsive layouts, and build/runtime health. All requested checks passed.
action_items: No functional fixes required from this test run.
Optional: quickly sanity-check external destinations in a manual browser once before release.
critical_code_review_comments: Good: external links consistently use target='_blank' with rel='noopener noreferrer'.
Good: Publication routes preserve accessibility focus intent via heading focus and active sidebar states.
Potential maintainability watch: many publication page spacings are tightly hardcoded for viewport-height breakpoints; keep an eye on future content growth.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on https://portfolio-landing-96.preview.emergentagent.com. Verified /portfolio/writing and /portfolio/patent direct loads, sidebar Home/Work/Writing/Patent + logo navigation, disabled Profile/Contact behavior, active yellow marker, aria-current states, heading/title updates, all six external destinations (plus article image links), safe new-tab attrs, image loading, no horizontal overflow at 768/390/320, no unnecessary vertical scroll at 1920x800 and 1920x1259 with writing CTAs visible, no carousel on Writing/Patent, existing landing Portfolio entry and Work carousel route still functional, yarn build successful.
rca of the issue: No defects reproduced in scoped frontend checks; no RCA required.
